name: KAM Plastics Corp
old_description: KAM Plastics Corp is a manufacturer of injection molded components and subassemblies.  Our products are used in automotive (Tier 2 or lower), furniture, military and recreational vehicle applications, to name a few. External and internal issues, including interested parties (and customer requirements) that are relevant to KAM and our QMS are identified in our One Page Planning process.  Product warranty is currently not required by our customers.
about:
KAM Plastics Corp was founded in 1994 in Holland, Michigan, by Paul Kalkman and Cleon Morgan. The company became employee-owned through an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) in 2004, reaching full employee ownership by 2012 after the founders retired.

The company specializes in plastic injection molding and assembly, operating over 50 molding machines across facilities in Holland, Michigan, and Arteaga, Mexico (via the KAMEX joint venture). Capabilities include two-shot molding, insert molding, and value-added processes such as chrome plating, painting, and pad printing. A product development and launch team supports customers from concept through production.

KAM serves automotive (Tier 2 and below), furniture, military, recreational vehicle, and consumer product markets. Early projects included the Ford Roll Up Window Handle (1995) and the Ford Ground Illumination Light Module (2000), and the company notes its parts can be found on products from leading U.S. companies.

The company emphasizes solving complex molding challenges — "We do the hard stuff" — and cites its employee-ownership culture, quality systems (IATF 16949:2016, ISO 9001), and tools like CMM inspection, 3D scanning, and 8D problem solving as differentiators.
